The problem

Keyword search makes you
already know the answer.

“something for a winter wedding”

1Unicra Bride Crystal Necklace Earrings

Shopilot0.954

1MisShow Women’s Rhinestone Long Lace Formal Dress
2Ever-Pretty Elegant Long Sleeve Formal Gown
3Adrianna Papell Ruffled Cascade Formal Dress

The baseline matched on the word “something”. No product is called “winter wedding” — so the words in the query and the words in the catalog never meet.

How one turn works

Multi-route retrieval → fusion → one chosen question

01

Parse & accumulate

Recognise the customer’s frames, recover constraints from free text when none matches, and carry every disclosure forward with an evidence weight. src/parse.py · src/state.py

02

Route on a continuous dial

A specificity score splits a precise buying filter from a diverse browsing spread — endpoints of one dial, not a branch. src/route.py

03

Retrieve over three routes

Exact constraint match, BM25, TF‑IDF cosine — each normalised to its own maximum, fused with per-track weights. Entirely in memory. src/rank.py · src/lexical.py

04

Choose the question by information gain

Not from a list: IG(a) = H(C) − E[H(C | reply)] over the live candidate posterior. Removing it costs 0.379 — more than everything else combined. src/clarify.py

05

Decide how much to return

An over-general pool gets one believed product, not ten guesses. A miss is evidence: anything already shown is provably not the target. src/agent.py
